# mcloud run

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

Run a scheduled function now, and show its output.

Start a run of a scheduled function (its CronJob) now, outside its
schedule, follow its logs, and say whether it succeeded. The run is
removed an hour after it ends.

```
mcloud run FUNCTION [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud run nightly
mcloud run nightly --app shop
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` string |  | the app (default: $MCLOUD\_APP, else maxcloud.yaml's) |
| `--timeout` duration | `1h0m0s` | stop following after this long (the run carries on) |
